faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bengal Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Assistant Hindi Officer/ Hindi Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Assistant Hindi Officer/ Hindi Officer posts is 15 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Hindi Officer/ Hindi Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Hindi or Hindi Translation with English as a subject at the Bachelor's Degree Level. Computer proficiency and typing skills are also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Hindi Officer/ Hindi Officer post is 32 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/PWD candidates and others as per government directives.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Hindi Officer/ Hindi Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of approximately Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Assistant Hindi Officer/ Hindi Officer post?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach required documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Test followed by an Interview for the eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Assistant Hindi Officer/ Hindi Officer post is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What are the computer proficiency requirements for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be computer friendly, possess typing skills in Hindi and English, and have a typing speed of 40 to 60 words per minute. They should also be capable of adhering to strict timelines and discipline.
